title: Downtown - Rooftop cinema & fire pit
description:
Luxury living in The Gulch. Designer-styled 4-bed condo with open plan, chef’s kitchen and floor-to-ceiling windows.
Enjoy a private rooftop deck with skyline views—ideal for sunset cocktails or bachelorette pics.
Walk 10 min to Broadway’s dining & music, then unwind with hotel-quality beds, fast Wi-Fi, smart TVs and in-unit laundry.
Hosted by a responsive Superhost.

The space
Highlights:
•	We own 8 units next to each other, larger groups please reach out. 
•	Private roof top deck with views, projector, grill and seating
•	Free parking in the 2 car garage
•	Walk Score 85 (walk to Gulch, cafes, dining, shopping, nightlife)
•	Fully equipped + stocked kitchen
•	5 minute drive to downtown Nashville

Perfect for larger groups or multiple families looking to travel together. Downtown is equipped with custom kitchens and professional appliances, designer spa like baths with Italian tile and faucets, incredible lighting, soaring ceilings, unique and beautiful wall treatments, and rooftop decks with 360 degrees views of downtown. Book now and make this the choice for your next group trip or work getaway to Music city. 

Bed Setup for this home:
 
★ Master Bedroom (3rd Level): King bed with suite bathroom
★ 2nd Bedroom (3rd Level): 2 full bunk beds - full bathroom right outside the room   
★ 3rd Bedroom (1st Level): Queen with full bath right outside the bedroom
★ 2 cots stored on site

Unwind Luxury Vacations is the professional management company for this home, and committed to curating your 5-star experience.

Guest access
Full access to the unit plus rooftop lounge.
